## Scientific/formal voice

An Integration Verification Contract is a versioned pre-execution specification of the tests, environments, measures, acceptance and rejection gates, failure handling, evidence requirements and challenge route needed before one Integration Option Review may support an implementation or owner Decision.

- Failed and inconclusive tests must be retained; a changed option, version or purpose requires contract review.
